test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Malayalam is the official language of the state of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kerala.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Malayalam is a **Dravidian language **vocalized in the Indian state of Kerala by the **Malayali**** people.**
 
• It is one of** 22 scheduled languages** of India and is vocalized by** 2.88% of Indians.**
 
• Malayalam was nominated as a "**Classical Language of India****" in 2013**.
 
• Malayalam has official language status in** Kerala, Lakshadweep, and, Puducherry also.**
 
• It is also **vocalized by the Malayali population**** worldwide**, especially in the **Persian gulf countrie**s, due to the large populations of **Malayali**** emigrants** there.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Urdu is the second official language of Telangana state**, but **English is used for all government documents and as a language of the courts.**
 
• The Andhra Pradesh Official Language Act 1966 is the core legislation to refer to with regard to Telugu.
 
• Marathi shall, as from the appointed day, be the language which has to be used for all official purposes mentioned in article 345 of the Indian Constitution,
